label: 墙
description: 在 Geometry DSL 末尾追加 wall(...) 一行：直墙段（length×height×thickness），可减去 openings 门/窗洞。当 prompt 提到 墙 / 隔墙 / 外墙 / wall / partition 时使用。
description-en: Append `wall(...)` — a straight wall segment (length×height×thickness) minus door/window openings. Use when the prompt mentions wall, partition, or exterior wall.

inputs.name: openings
inputs.label: 开口
inputs.description: 门/窗洞 JSON，每项 [x, width, sill, head]，如 [[1,0.9,0,2.1]]；x=洞心相对墙中点偏移
inputs.description-en: Openings JSON, each [x, width, sill, head], e.g. [[1,0.9,0,2.1]]; x = offset from wall midpoint.

inputs.name: window_band
inputs.label: 窗带
inputs.description: 开自动水平窗带（连续横向窗洞），作为逐个 openings 之外的选项
inputs.description-en: Cut a continuous horizontal window band as an alternative to per-opening cuts.

inputs.name: band_sill
inputs.label: 窗带下沿
inputs.description: 窗带下沿高度（Z，米）；0=按墙高自动

inputs.name: band_head
inputs.label: 窗带上沿
inputs.description: 窗带上沿高度（Z，米）；0=按墙高自动

inputs.name: band_margin
inputs.label: 窗带端垛
inputs.description: 窗带两端预留墙垛宽（X，米）；0=自动
inputs.description-en: End pier width kept at both ends of the band; 0 = auto.

inputs.name: pane_width
inputs.label: 单块宽
inputs.description: 窗带按目标单块宽度加竖挺划分；0=不划分
inputs.description-en: Divide the band into panes of this target width with mullions; 0 = single band.

inputs.name: plinth_height
inputs.label: 勒脚高
inputs.description: 底部勒脚基座高度（Z，米）；0=无

inputs.name: plinth_projection
inputs.label: 勒脚外挑
inputs.description: 勒脚相对墙面每侧外挑（Y，米）；0=默认
inputs.description-en: Plinth projection beyond the wall face per side (Y); 0 = default.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；空 = 自动 wall{n}

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 wall 行后的 Geometry

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.description: 本行 shape 的 id（供下游 g_part 的 shape_id 引用）
outputs.description-en: Id of the new shape (feed into a downstream g_part's shape_id).

outputs.name: opening_placements
outputs.label: 洞口摆放
outputs.description: 各洞口的建议窗/门摆放 JSON 数组（每项 {origin:[x,0,sill], width, height, depth}，相对墙局部坐标；以本墙 part 为父关节 origin 直接可用）
outputs.description-en: JSON array of suggested window/door placements per opening ({origin:[x,0,sill], width, height, depth}, in wall-local coords; usable as-is for a joint parented to this wall part).

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: 错误
outputs.description: 非致命错误信息；非空表示本行被丢弃
outputs.description-en: Non-fatal error; non-empty means the line was dropped.
